title: 第465章 温斯顿一无所知第464章 卡洛琳
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆第一卷：默认第465章温斯顿一无所知（..la）一处看起来颇为考究的二层白色别墅前，雨水正顺着屋檐连成线地往下落。
伴随着马蹄踏在平整水泥路面上的“哒哒”
声，一辆做工精致的马车稳稳停在了别墅的大铁门外。
温斯顿从马车上迈步下来，撑开一把纯黑色的雨伞，快步穿过庭院，回到了自己的家门前。
他停在由两根粗壮白石圆柱支撑的延伸屋檐下。
还没等他伸手敲门，家里的佣人便注意到了外面的动静，第一时间从里面将那扇厚重的橡木大门打开了。
温斯顿顺手甩了甩手中的黑伞，将伞面上沾染的水珠甩落，随即将伞递给佣人，一边解开微湿的外套扣子一边问道：“夫人和卡洛琳她们回来了没有？”
“没有，先生。”
女佣人双手接过雨伞，恭敬地回道：“夫人和小姐她们今天出去逛街了，不过出门时并没有带伞，这会儿雨下得这么大，或许正在哪里避雨呢。”
“这样啊……”
温斯顿闻言，抬头看了一眼略微有些昏暗阴沉的天空，眉头不由得微微皱了一下。
这天都快黑了。
不过……
有凯瑟琳陪在身边，应该出不了什么问题。
要是今天只有卡洛琳那个小丫头一个人在外面，他现在倒真要派人去找了。
他的夫人凯瑟琳向来是个极有主意的聪明女人。
温斯顿心里很清楚，自己如今的生意能做得这么大，甚至在整个枫叶城都闯出了一定的名声，凯瑟琳在背后可是起到了不可磨灭的作用。
有她在，倒不至于出什么问题。
女佣将雨伞妥善收好后，走回客厅轻声询问道：“先生，晚饭已经做好了，要不您先吃？”
她顿了顿，又补充道：“等夫人和小姐回来了，我再重新为她们做一份热乎的就是了。”
温斯顿略微思索了一下，摇了摇头拒绝道：“算了，现在也快到点了，你就先下班回去休息吧。
夫人和小姐那边，等她们回来了自己会解决的。”
他走到壁炉旁的真皮沙发上坐下，语气轻松了几分：“都这个点了还没回来，我估计是她们见雨实在太大，索性就在外面找了家餐厅，一边吃着晚饭一边等雨停了。”
现在的枫叶城因为领主大人的扩建和发展，城区面积变得极大，这种恶劣的天气里，漫无目的地出去找人根本就不现实。
他索性也就不去操那份闲心了。
反正如今的枫叶城治安好得很，每条街道都有全副武装的警察和巡逻队日夜巡视，绝对不会出什么安全问题。
女佣顺从地点了点头：“好的，先生。”
这位年轻的女佣其实并不是温斯顿家的女仆，而只是在劳务市场上花钱雇佣来的自由民女佣。
理论上来讲，她每天的工作时间只需要上十二个小时，也就是从早上五点一直工作到下午五点。
主要负责这一家三口的洗衣、做饭以及日常的打扫卫生等工作。
不过这种家庭雇佣的活计总是很难卡得那么准点，遇到主人家有事或者晚归，她经常需要留下来加班，而且这些多出来的加班时间并没有额外的加班费。
这份工作说实话，还是挺辛苦的。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The daughter of a down-and-out noble was forced to become my maid Volume 1: Default Chapter 465 Winston knows nothing (..la) In front of a two-story white villa that looks quite elegant, rainwater is falling in a line along the eaves.
Accompanied by the "click-click" sound of the horse's hooves on the smooth cement road
With a sound, a finely crafted carriage stopped steadily outside the large iron gate of the villa.
Winston stepped down from the carriage, opened a pure black umbrella, walked quickly across the courtyard, and returned to his home.
He stopped under an extended eaves supported by two thick white stone columns.
Before he could reach out to knock on the door, the servant at home noticed the movement outside and immediately opened the heavy oak door from the inside.
Winston swung the black umbrella in his hand to shake off the water droplets on the umbrella. Then he handed the umbrella to the servant and asked while unbuttoning his slightly wet coat: "Are Madam and Caroline back?"
"No, sir."
The maid took the umbrella with both hands and replied respectfully: "Madam and Miss, they went shopping today, but they didn't bring an umbrella with them when they went out. It's raining so hard right now, maybe they are taking shelter somewhere."
"That's it..."
After hearing this, Winston raised his head and glanced at the slightly dark and gloomy sky, and couldn't help but frown slightly.
It's almost dark today.
But...
With Catherine by my side, nothing should go wrong.
If that little girl Caroline was alone outside today, he would really send someone to find her now.
His wife, Catherine, has always been a smart woman with great ideas.
Winston knew very well that Catherine had played an indelible role behind the scenes for his business to be so big and famous throughout Maple Leaf City.
With her here, there won't be any problems.
After the maid put away the umbrella properly, she walked back to the living room and asked softly: "Sir, dinner is already ready, how about you eat first?"
She paused and then added: "When the madam and young lady come back, I will just make them a hot meal again."
Winston thought for a moment, shook his head and refused: "Forget it, it's almost one o'clock now, so you should go back to rest after get off work.
Madam and young lady, I will sort it out when they come back. "
He walked to sit on the leather sofa next to the fireplace and said in a more relaxed tone: "It's already this o'clock and I haven't come back yet. I guess they saw that the rain was really heavy, so they simply found a restaurant outside and had dinner while waiting for the rain to stop."
Due to the expansion and development of the Lord, the current Maple Leaf City has become extremely large. In such bad weather, it is simply unrealistic to go out looking for people aimlessly.
He simply didn't care about that leisurely thing.
Anyway, the public security in Maple Leaf City is very good now. Every street has fully armed police and patrol teams patrolling day and night. There will definitely be no safety problems.
The maid nodded obediently: "Okay, sir."
This young maid is not actually the maid of the Winston family, but just a freedman maid hired in the labor market.
Theoretically, she only needs to work twelve hours a day, that is, from five in the morning to five in the afternoon.
Mainly responsible for the laundry, cooking and daily cleaning of the family of three.
However, it is always difficult to get this kind of family employment work on time. When the owner has something to do or comes home late, she often needs to stay and work overtime, and there is no additional overtime pay for these extra overtime hours.
To be honest, this job is quite hard.
